```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Pitching Data
```{r}
pitching <- 
  read_csv(here::here("colney/mlb_k-means/exploration/pitchers_2024.csv")) %>%
  select(-2,-3) %>%
  rename(
    name = `last_name, first_name`
  )
```

```{r}
write_csv(pitching, "mlb_pitching_2024.csv")
```


# Batting Data
```{r}
batting <-
  read_csv(here::here("colney/mlb_k-means/exploration/batters_2024.csv")) %>%
  select(-2,-3) %>%
  rename(
    name = `last_name, first_name`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hr_per_hit = round(home_run / hit, 3),
    k_rate = k_percent / 100
  ) %>%
  select(-2, -4, -5, -6)
```

```{r}
write_csv(batting, "mlb_batting_2024.csv")
```
